1.why: All screens use a clean, legible sans-serif typeface with comfortable line spacing on headings and body text, though letter spacing appears standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: Instruction sentences are short, sentence-case, and non-italic with no dense blocks, but the 'STEP 1 OF 5' progress label is set in all caps on every screen.

3.why: The single-column layout with labelled full-width inputs and a large button renders cleanly at the narrow mobile width shown in all four screenshots.

4.why: Instructions are one short plain sentence each (e.g., 'Confirm your bank account details to protect higher-value payments'), but the heading and subtitle use the unexplained acronym 'MFA enrolment'.

5.why: Both fields are pre-filled with example values (marcus@example.test, +15551234567) and helper text explicitly states 'use the displayed example details.'

6.why: No screen contains more than a single-sentence instruction; the longest text block anywhere is one line.

7.why: No long codes, secrets, or copy controls appear in any screenshot, and the flow never advances past sign-in to reveal any.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is visible on any of the four screens.

9.why: No password field exists anywhere in the observed flow and there is no visible evidence of autofill support beyond standard labelled text inputs.

10.why: The current step is labelled ('STEP 1 OF 5') and the blue 'Continue securely' button is visually dominant, though the step label itself is small and low-emphasis.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one primary action, the 'Continue securely' button, with no competing calls to action.

12.why: After submitting, the system only shows 'Unable to sign in with those details' with no indication of what comes next, and the 'Logs' panel remains empty across all four screenshots.

13.why: The form retains entered values and can be resubmitted with no lockout or penalty message across repeated attempts, but no codes exist in the observed flow so reveal/hide/re-request controls cannot be confirmed.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details' does not blame the user, but it states the failure only vaguely and offers no guidance on how to fix it.

15.why: No timer, countdown, or expiry warning appears on any screen, but code entry is never reached so the generosity of entry time cannot be verified.
